reason: The Simple-PHP-Code-Parser case was recorded twice, a year apart in effect: raw ranking reached the decisive AST API and governed context did not. The second replay found the mechanism - the derived search index had a reader in workflow approve and no writer anywhere, so Recall compiled no ranked facts at all and approve reported success. The durable rule is that an unavailable evidence channel must announce itself, because a smaller well-formed context is indistinguishable from a correct one. Scope names the compile entrypoint and the frozen replays that measure the chain.
new: When decisive evidence is missing from a governed context, first establish where it was lost along map discovery, Recall selection and context projection. Widening search, changing ranking or raising the context budget is a last resort and must be recorded in the frozen replay.
boundary: Applies to governed context compilation. It does not constrain what an agent may read interactively outside the governed run.
